newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela Nov car sales up 22 pct vs year ago.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela Nov car sales up 22 pct vs year ago.

text.p: Vehicle sales in Venezuela rose 21.8 percent in November to 7,514, compared to 6,170 in November 1995 to mark the first year-on-year increase in car sales this year, the Venezuelan Automobile Chamber (CAVENEZ) said Monday.
Vehicle sales in November were also up 17.2 percent from 6,414 units in October, the CAVENEZ figures showed.
But sales for the first 11 months of the year, at 53,054 units, were still down 31.2 percent from 77,090 in the same period last year.
In November 6,573 or 87 percent of the vehicles sold were assembled locally, while 941 or 13 percent were imported.
In November 1995, 5,687 or 92 percent were locally assembled, and 483 or eight percent were imported.
In the period from January to November 1996, 47,698 or 90 percent were assembled locally and 5,356 or 10 percent were imported.
Between January and November 1995, 74,963 or 97 percent were assembled locally and 2,127 or three percent were imported.

General Motors Corp led the Venezuelan market with 26 percent of total sales in the first 11 months. Ford Motor Co followed with 21 percent, Toyota Motor Corp with 19 percent and Fiat SpA with 13 percent.
